summary: Onboarding snr.bell.ca with a two-step (username->Next->password) login; after support configured it, crawl missed many /User/ pages and some pages failed scan.
mechanism: Multi-step login configured by support; crawler then lost session: hit /servlet/Logout and /authnz/user-check (HTTP 401), short inactivity timeout, Group vs User areas need separate logins that revoke each other, parallel workers. Later remaining failures: engine language-attribute-vs-content check threw error and dropped pages (Site Scanner only); finally concurrent GROUP+USERS scans with the same account caused portal to reject login.
resolution: Multi-step login on backend; exclude regex for /servlet/Logout and authnz; split into GROUP and USERS properties; speed tier slow (single browser); maxPagesCount 100->250; seed URLs added as starting pages; language check disabled on USERS property, fixed in analysis-web 16.34.10 (CS-2802); advise not to scan both properties concurrently.
log_signals: [browser] [error] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 401 (Unauthorized)
final url redirected to /authnz/user-check or login page
ui_signals: results show login page instead of actual page

summary: Customer requested WCAG 2.0 A/AA-only scans across ~11 properties; 2.2 Target Size still appeared; also glentel.com pages came back empty/'Untitled'.
mechanism: Default runs all WCAG levels/versions. Property-level enginesConfiguration needed (AXE_CONFIG runOnly wcag2a/wcag2aa, USE_LOCKED_TEXT_SPACING_VALIDATOR false); Target Size still emitted until ENABLE_AXE_OPT_IN=false added. Temporary test page cap (10/50) caused low page counts. glentel.com: site/CDN rate limit HTTP 429 -> empty captured pages. cloudkettle.com 301-redirects to ateko.com. sdktek/protexxa: 'final url not included in whitelist'.
resolution: Retool property-level config (TOGGLES + AXE_CONFIG runOnly + ENABLE_AXE_OPT_IN:false) applied to all properties; CS-2738 for Target Size leak; FR CS-2680 for showing WCAG version in UI; glentel needs IP allowlist on site side.
log_signals: not including url in result url set. reason: final url not included in whitelist
ui_signals: no WCAG version indicator in UI
